test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: The government deals with fiscal policy.
Fiscal policy deals with the supply of money in the economy and the rate of interest.
Fiscal policy includes tax policy, expenditure policy, investment or disinvestment strategies and debt or surplus management.
Fiscal policy is linked with general economic policy strategy of the country.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fiscal policy deals with the supply of money in the economy and the rate of interest.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Fiscal policy refers to the use of government spending and tax policies to influence economic conditions.
 
• The government deals with fiscal policy.
 
• Fiscal policy includes tax policy, expenditure policy, investment or disinvestment strategies and debt or surplus management.
 
• Fiscal policy is linked with the general economic policy strategy of the country.
 
• **Monetary policy deals with the supply of money in the economy and the rate of interest.**
 
• **Hence Statement 2 is incorrect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives of Fiscal policy**

 
 
• To promote economic growth
 
 
• Government promotes economic growth by setting up basic and heavy industries like steel, chemical, fertilizers, machine tools, etc.
 
 
 
• To reduce income and wealth inequalities. 
 
• To provide employment opportunities
 
• To ensure stability in prices
 
• To correct the balance of payments deficit
 
• To provide for effective administration
